# Step - barrier

`barrier` · category: [Aggregation](../../traversal/step_reference.md#aggregation)

Collects the whole stream before passing it on; equal traversers merge into one with a bulk (see the book page Bulk and Barriers).

## Forms

```text
barrier()
barrier(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().out().barrier().count().next()   // 6
```

## See also

- [Bulk and Barriers](../../users_guide/bulk_and_barriers.md)
